newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Weather-Rough conditions seen in seas off S.Lanka.
newsitem.headline: Weather-Rough conditions seen in seas off S.Lanka.

text.p: Sri Lanka's metereological department forecast rough surface conditions over seas off the island's southwest, south and southeast coasts for Sunday.
The department said in a statement on Saturday that occasional rain or thundershowers and strong westerly winds will be experienced in the Indian Ocean.

It forecast scattered showers accompanied by thunder at times in the Western, Sabaragamuwa and Southern provinces and thunder showers at a number of places in Uva, Eastern, and Northcentral provinces of Sri Lanka on Sunday.
